scope: Native UUID value identity through bound parameters and SQL literals
before_fix: The new DuckDB assertion failed: a bound UUID cast to native UUID returned Value::Text("12345678-9abc-def0-1122-334455667788") instead of Value::Uuid with the same identifier.
contract: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, ClickHouse and DuckDB preserve Value::Uuid through parameter binding and SQL-literal replay.
A typed SQL NULL remains Value::Null.

focused_contract.command: rtk cargo test --offline --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres -p tablepro-driver-mssql -p tablepro-driver-clickhouse -p tablepro-driver-duckdb --test integration value_contract_preserves_scalar_boundaries_through_parameters_and_exports -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1
focused_contract.result: 4 passed, 0 failed; one selected test in each driver package

remaining: The four-engine UUID contract does not establish support for UUID editing/export in every app consumer or every driver. Broader B3 remains open.
